rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs from ADA/NDA-affiliated dental associations, accredited dental schools or other Board-approved sponsors. Categories (OAC 4715-8-01): dental education/scientific courses unlimited (incl. ethics, regulatory compliance, risk management); non-clinical practice management max 5 h; papers/presentations max 3 h; teaching/research max 3 h; volunteer clinical service up to one-third; poster sessions max 2 h. Formats: directly interactive or supervised self-instruction with test (pass 75%).
rules.alternatives: Board may excuse for unusual circumstance, emergency or hardship: exemptions for recent graduates in their first registration and full-time students; extensions for military, health (max 1 year) or lost records; waivers when precluded from active practice.
rules.audit_note: Sworn affidavit at biennial registration listing programs; keep records at least 4 years; Board selects applications annually for verification (30 days to respond).
rules.notes: License valid two years from issuance (biennial registration fee $312). Credit: 1 hour per 50-60 contact minutes. Prescribers of opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines must certify OARRS access at registration.
